human_summary: Two university students, Redwan and Apu, were killed early on 12 December 2025 when a Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) garbage truck reportedly struck their motorcycle in the Konapara area of Demra, Dhaka [ev_2e2e59eb3bfdfb64, ev_5a4ec4c3f6f0abd5]. The incident was reported by at least three independent outlets: The Business Standard (web and social), tbsnews.net, and Dhaka Tribune, with corroborating visual evidence from a composite news graphic [ev_1d44c58721ec92c0, ev_3800704948f1c63d, ev_f967ca19b4c62d12]. The event time has day-level precision for 12 December, with an additional attributed claim putting the crash around 4:30am when the victims were returning from a wedding event, as stated by classmate Tausif [ev_738d53c92c9d089d]. Casualties are consistently reported as two fatalities and zero injuries across sources. Involved vehicles are a motorcycle and the DNCC garbage truck; one source also mentioned a bus in a general traffic safety comment. Location is represented as an area-level gazetteer centroid for Konapara, Demra, not an exact crash point [ev_244b71a7a2c0143a]. No traffic delays, emergency response, or later developments were reported. A reader comment speculates on shared fault without evidence [ev_bc4144b4e776d8ef]. The most significant unresolved uncertainty is the precise crash time and exact location on the ground, as only an approximate area and time are provided.
